violated_contract: A dev sync process sharing production Firestore and Redis must not discover, claim, or mutate production sequencer jobs, leases, retry state, or dispatch guards.
canonical_prevention: Bind the legacy UID sequencer registry to the production runtime, reject non-production registry access before any I/O, and scope other shared sync Redis and Firestore state by runtime stage while preserving existing production paths. Test the dev process against seeded production state and require a per-UID cutover wait.
